01 Studio Clean cln_
0% Saturation / Maximum Headroom. Pure linear RLC resonance response with zero magnetic compression. Ideal for pristine DI and clean funk.
α = 0.00 | V_sat = 10.0V
02 Standard Dynamic std_
Standard Give & Bloom. 100% nominal target dynamic modeling: magnetic string drag damping, 2f0 orbit bloom, dynamic inductance sag (λ_L), and soft-knee compression.
α = α_tgt | V_sat = V_tgt
03 Hot Rod hot_
175% Overwound Pre-Conditioner. Saturated attack give, compressed low-mids, and elevated harmonic punch to drive downstream Darkglass engines.
α = 1.75 × α_tgt | V_sat / 1.35
